summary: Kenon Holdings filed a 6-K reporting that its subsidiary OPC Energy agreed to sell the entity holding its Israeli distributed energy business to a wholly-owned subsidiary of Aluma Infrastructure Fund (2020) Ltd. Aggregate consideration is approximately NIS 272 million (~$90 million), subject to interest and other adjustments; the unit has about 52.2 MW of gas-fired generation operational or nearing completion. Conditions precedent must be satisfied within 180 days of signing, including Israel Competition Authority approval. OPC must fund completion of unfinished facilities and provide long-term gas and electricity supply arrangements. Watch regulatory clearance timing and construction-cost overruns affecting net proceeds.
